name: Rizuhble's Bullet Hose McGinnis
rows: Getting poked out in lane. Sell it when slots fill.
Sell it last for a counter.
Buy it earlier if most of their damage is spirit.
Get after Fleetfoot if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Battle Vest for it.
They dive you and you've got no way out.
Most of their damage is gun.
Slows and hexes keep you from getting away.
Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.
Big spirit bursts keep killing you.
Divers keep killing you even after Warp Stone.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Style change turret/spirit → gun, built from the tracklock pro data (45 games, 62% WR): Intensifying Magazine 98%, Monster Rounds 98%, Extended Magazine 87%, Swift Striker 78%, Rapid Rounds 71%; Quicksilver Reload 89%, Fleetfoot 84%, Mercurial Magnum 82%, Escalating Resilience 67%, Enduring Speed 64%, Bullet Lifesteal 42%; Spiritual Overflow 38%, Spirit Lifesteal 36%, Spirit Resilience 36%, Berserker 36%, Vampiric Burst 24%. Same core as deadlocked.gg and the lockbuilds gun builds. Renamed.

Gun 4.8k at 4.8k souls (Monster Rounds, Extended, Intensifying, Rapid Rounds → Swift Striker). Cultist at ~8 min on top. Health 4.8k at 13.6k (Enduring Speed, Bullet Lifesteal, Grit → Reactive Barrier); Medicinal Specter is kit sustain, so that timing is fine.
Quicksilver Reload → Mercurial Magnum imbued on Mini Turret: turret is an 18s-cooldown cast with charges, so it procs the reload and spirit bullets every fight. Magnum counts as a gun item.

Battle Vest (62% pro early) is a lane option, not core, because it never upgrades. Intensifying Magazine also has no upgrade and is kept all game as in 98% of pro builds. Cultist is the sell slot for counters and for Crippling Headshot.

Dropped the whole turret core (Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge, Compress/Superior Cooldown, Expansion, Mystic Vulnerability/Escalating Exposure, Duration, Infuser, Diviner's Kevlar, Echo Shard, Spirit Burn, Boundless). Core 12 slots, 40k (was 54.4k). Ability order now takes Spectral Wall T1 (+20% damage amp on hit) early.

Ability order: Gun style on the public frame (mobalytics/seemeta unlock 3-2-1-4): Spectral Wall T1 (+20% damage amp on hit) at 5 for the gun, Mini Turret T1/T2 at 6-7 so the +2 charges land with Quicksilver/Mercurial on the turret, Wall maxed 8-9 (mobalytics 77-80%), Turret T3 10, Specter 11-12, Barrage 13-15 as public, Specter T3 last.

Round 9: Cultist Sacrifice dropped; Monster Rounds stays and is sold for Crippling Headshot. tracklock.gg pro builds, last 30 days, checked 2026-10-19: Monster Rounds 98% but Cultist 12%. McGinnis farms fine with turrets, so the 2.4k upgrade was spent on farm she doesn't need.

Round 9: Battle Vest from the lane box into Early core (6.4k): tracklock.gg pro builds, last 30 days, checked 2026-10-19 64% early; +18% weapon damage, +7% fire rate and 18% bullet resist above 65% health win her gun trades. It's a damage item too, so it doesn't belong in the survival-only lane box.

Round 9: Grit into Reactive Barrier dropped (pros: Grit 43% mid, Reactive Barrier not in the top 24); health spike now Sprint Boots, Enduring Speed, Battle Vest, Bullet Lifesteal = 4.8k at 11.2k (was 13.6k). Indomitable removed from the rich box (its Reactive Barrier is gone). Counters now sell Battle Vest. Core 40.0k to 37.6k, still 12 slots.

Round 9: Worth a try: Ballistic Enchantment on Mini Turret. +20 weapon damage per hero the turret hits, for 20s; the turret shoots every 0.2s from 30m, so it stays up the whole fight. Also +22% turret range.
Round 10: Crippling Headshot rich note now says what it does (it only named the sell). Nothing else changed: the core matches tracklock pro McGinnis (last 30 days, 42 games) phase by phase.
Round 12: removed the Worth a try box (Ballistic Enchantment on the turret).
Round 13: notes emptied per UPDATE 3 (only sells, swaps, slot locked, counters and verified tips kept); desc shortened to a style label (UPDATE 4).

Round 14: renamed (old name was 34 characters). Crippling Headshot out of the rich box (not a pricier version of anything in the build); Divine Barrier in as the pricier Dispel Magic. Spirit Resilience note had Haze (no ticking spirit damage) and 'Viper': now says when to buy it earlier. Monster Rounds, Fleetfoot and Swift Striker sell for counters. Counterspell and Ethereal Shift notes made concrete.

Round 15: Counters desc was 116 characters (game limit 112): now 'Get after Fleetfoot … Sell Battle Vest for it.' (109). Intensifying Magazine was the only T1/T2 with no upgrade or named sell: now 'Sell it last for a counter.'

Round 19: style check, no change. Gun McGinnis is a real public style (lockbuilds FaxFox Mcg, Phantom VI, Oct 8: Monster Rounds, Extended/Intensifying Magazine, Swift Striker, Quicksilver, Enduring Speed, Fleetfoot, Mercurial Magnum, Berserker, Escalating Resilience) and Kieran's main.
Round 20: Late list filled to ~74k from FaxFox's late box: Ricochet, Lucky Shot, Crippling Headshot, Silencer, Inhibitor, then Divine Barrier, each selling the weakest item left.
Round 25: order 3211134332221444 → 3231114223231444: Spectral Wall T1 (+20% damage) 3rd, Medicinal Specter T1/T2 before Wall T2, Specter T3 before Wall T3.
